reviewScope: MRWorkshop source lifecycle, docking, queued UI actions, recenter recovery and explicit production-rig bindings. Focus runtime reviewed read-only; pre-existing Focus configuration was not edited.

confirmedDefects.issue: SDK input-source Disable emits Unselect, which was treated as a physical docking release and could dispatch a UI click while HMD availability stayed true.
confirmedDefects.sdkTrace: Meta207 Interactor.Disable -> UnselectInteractable -> PointerInteractor.InteractableUnselected -> PointerEventType.Unselect; PointableCanvasModule turns Unselect into queued release/click.
confirmedDefects.fix: Explicit identifier/device source registry, Disabled-event cancellation, live tracked-source validation, deferred release source revision, and UI press source/availability revisions. Genuine SDK Unselect remains admitted.

confirmedDefects.issue: Workshop placement and pending actions survived a tracking-space recenter when headset availability stayed true.
confirmedDefects.fix: Subscribe to OVRDisplay.RecenteredPose during XR operation, unsubscribe on disable, suspend/reset on the event, then use the existing head-relative placement path on readiness recovery.

correctedRed.fixtureCorrection: The initial red fixture asserted after one yielded frame, before deferred LateUpdate docking. Three SDK release/disable cases now yield two frames.

firstGreen.cause: The real SDK ControllerHandGrabInteractor intentionally contains both a HandRef and ControllerRef; nearest-device-only selection rejected that composition.
firstGreen.followUp: HandGrab binding now uses the SDK Hand property, or the exact serialized SDK _hand reference before Awake. The production-prefab test asserts reference identity.

finalGreen.scope: Actual Unity PlayMode execution; source device data and head poses remain simulated.

finalHostCompilation.scope: C# source compilation against installed Unity/Meta assemblies. Does not execute Unity, and excludes UNITY_EDITOR test branches.

bindingLifecycleCorrection.cause: Active edit-time generation could read SDK Identifier before its runtime Awake initialized it.
bindingLifecycleCorrection.fix: Edit-time Bind serializes references only. Initial runtime registration waits until source Start; subsequent OnEnable reattaches after that. Identifier is acquired before the subscribed field is assigned.
bindingLifecycleCorrection.actualActiveEditTimeGeneration: Pending root-coordinated scene generation and saved-scene inspection.

regressionCoverage: Actual imported GrabInteractor Enable/ProcessCandidate/Hover/Select then device disconnect plus Preprocess.
Actual imported GrabInteractor explicit Disable while its simulated device remains connected.
Actual SDK genuine Unselect docks exactly once.
Actual SDK selection is cancelled by global tracking suspension.
Invalid simulated controller pose cancels delayed docking and does not revive it on recovery.
Queued Unity UI handler click is rejected after source loss, source recovery or headset availability recovery; fresh valid clicks still work.
Recenter handler invocation cancels pending release/power and exercises replacement using a changed simulated head pose.
Actual imported WorkshopPlatform prefab instantiated inactive: exact source/device references, one binding per supported interactor, idempotent binding, explicit missing/ambiguous rejection.
evidenceLimits: Device data and selector signals in the lifecycle fixture are simulated; SDK interactor lifecycle code is real.
UI tests exercise ExecuteEvents handler boundaries; they do not execute the full SDK canvas raycast/module flow or physical hand/controller controls.
Recenter tests directly invoke the handler and placement method. They do not demonstrate live OVRDisplay event subscription/delivery on Quest.
Inactive prefab binding inspection does not initialize XR or by itself establish successful active edit-time generation.
Connected/tracked/confident source checks cannot prove physical user intent. They distinguish source invalidation/disable from normal SDK unselection within this app's current configuration.
